name: Charlene Tham
title: Psychologist
description: Charlene has worked with a diverse range of clients, from children to adults, including priority cohorts (such as LGBTIQ+ community). The presentations worked with include depression, anxiety, domestic violence, trauma, suicidality, binge eating and intellectual disability. Currently training in Gottman Method Couples Therapy.
specialties: LGBTIQ+, trauma, domestic violence, couples, anxiety, depression

name: Samantha (Sam) Minerds
title: Psychologist
description: Sam has worked with a diverse range of clients, including people from CALD populations, LBGTIQ+ community, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and women and children escaping family violence. This experience has provided her with invaluable skills in therapeutic crisis intervention, deescalating a crisis, and safety planning.
specialties: LGBTIQ+, family violence, crisis intervention, CALD

name: Madeleine Anbar
title: Counsellor; Family & Relationship Services Unit Team Leader
description: She has extensive experience supporting individuals, couples and families experiencing anxiety, depression, stress, trauma, relationship difficulties and major life transitions. Her experience spans perinatal mental health, attachment and bonding, partner relationship challenges, trauma-informed practice and family violence. Trained in Gottman Method Couples Therapy.
specialties: trauma, perinatal, couples, family violence, Gottman

name: Lauren Davidson
title: Mental Health Counsellor & Social Worker
description: Lauren is a mental health counsellor and social worker with more than 20 years' experience working with individuals and families across complex and high-risk contexts. She is highly skilled in client-inclusive practice, family violence, trauma-informed practice and therapeutic family work, and is a trained family therapist.
specialties: trauma-informed practice, family violence, family therapy, postpartum
